provenance.scope: local reference panels, no new database retrieval; in silico screening only; no independent holdout or wet-lab testing
provenance.limits: target product 60–650 bp; background inter-primer distance 0–1000 bp; <=2 mismatches per primer and exact terminal 3; background WC<=3 and GT<=2 also counted; structures at 50nM per variant and 200nM per direction; salts50mM Mg1.5mM dNTP0.6mM; gates structureTm<55C, primerTm45–75C, midpoint delta<=5C; non-target four counts must not exceed original; all design records covered; at least3 records; 5prime trim min18nt
provenance.locus_validation: fixed homologous sites or unique closest raw pair plus both original aligned terminal8 agreement; not full phylogenetic reconstruction
provenance.classification: existing order labels; 28S exact species-name transfer only; unresolved species excluded from design, raw all-target scans retained
